item.tib: dpal ldan lha mo 'od 'chang ma'i gsang sgrub
item.coloph: ma cig thugs rje kun sgrol gyis/ ma 'ongs kho bo 'phags btsun la/ mi 'gyur pad+ma g.yung drung zhes/ ma cig yum gyi gsang gter tshul/ ma snyan snyan rgyud tshul du gnang / ma nor mi dmigs sems la 'chang / ma 'ongs bon gyi lha grogs rnams/ ma 'gyong yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ ma 'ongs 'gro ba'i don ched du/ ma bskung shes tshad yi ger btab/ ma cig thugs dang ci 'gal yang*/ ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags/ ma sgrib ye shes dngos grub rtsol//
